k1.author: seed
k1.text: Call svc.apply(app) with the application dict; it returns a dict.

k10.author: worker-B
k10.quote: For every partner in the network, whatever the partner decided, an application from a self_employed applicant whose requested_limit is above 6000 must be placed in manual review (queue_review) instead of being issued. A decline stays a decline.
k10.text: The network referral rule (self_employed + requested_limit > 6000) applies to ALL partners, not just Redfern. It overrides an "approved" outcome (convert to queue_review) but never overrides a "declined" outcome (decline stays a decline).

k2.author: worker-B
k2.quote: svc.apply now returns {"api_version": 2, "result": {"outcome": "approved" | "declined" | "manual_review", "credit_limit": <int>}}. The v1 fields `decision` and `limit` are removed.
k2.text: svc.apply (API v2, current) returns {"api_version": 2, "result": {"outcome": "approved" | "declined" | "manual_review", "credit_limit": int}}. The v1 fields `decision` and `limit` are removed.

k3.author: seed
k3.text: handle(app, svc) returns {action, limit}; action `issue` uses the returned limit, action `decline` has limit 0.

k4.author: worker-B
k4.quote: outcome manual_review replaces refer and is handled as in spec section 3.
k4.text: Handling rules (API v2): outcome approved -> issue with returned credit_limit; declined -> decline; manual_review (replaces v1 refer) -> queue_review (do NOT decline).

k5.author: worker-B
k5.quote: an application from a self_employed applicant whose requested_limit is above 6000 must be placed in manual review (queue_review) instead of being issued. A decline stays a decline.
k5.text: Network referral rule (applies to all partners): a self_employed applicant whose requested_limit is strictly above 6000 must be placed in queue_review instead of being issued; a decline stays a decline.

k6.author: worker-B
k6.quote: Application fields: id, age, income, employment (employed or self_employed), requested_limit.
k6.text: Redfern application fields: id, age, income, employment (employed or self_employed), requested_limit.

k7.author: worker-B
k7.text: API v2 confirmed live: svc_call with a valid application returns {"api_version": 2, "result": {"outcome": "approved", "credit_limit": 5000}}.

k8.author: worker-B
k8.quote: refer: the application is not decided; place it in the manual review queue (action queue_review) and do not decline it.
k8.text: Ticket KF-14 ops-lead comment ("just decline them in the handler") is WRONG: per Redfern spec section 3, manual_review (v1 refer) is an undecided application that must be queued (action queue_review), NOT declined. Do not send a decline letter for manual_review outcomes.

k9.author: worker-B
k9.quote: an application from a self_employed applicant whose requested_limit is above 6000 must be placed in manual review (queue_review) instead of being issued.
k9.text: Network referral rule uses STRICTLY above 6000 (requested_limit > 6000). An applicant with requested_limit exactly 6000 is NOT subject to the rule and can be issued if approved.
